summary.verdict_msg: Both apples-to-apples comparisons pass. Brian2 7-channel RIM matches Nicoletti's NEURON RIM within tolerance for both voltage-clamp and 5000 ms current-clamp protocols.

component_cp5_voltage_clamp.tolerance_metric: divergence(a,b,peak) = |a-b| / max(|a|, |b|, 0.1*peak); per-feature pass: divergence ≤ 0.05; per-panel pass: > 80% of holds clear ALL features
